story_type: crew spacecraft undocks and returns empty after thruster trouble
hook: This spaceship left its two astronauts behind in space.
narration: This spaceship pulled away from the space station empty. Its two astronauts stayed behind.
Boeing's Starliner had carried NASA astronauts Butch Wilmore and Suni Williams up on June fifth, 2024, its first flight with a crew.
But as it approached the station, it sprang helium leaks, and its steering thrusters gave trouble.
So for the safety of the astronauts, NASA decided Starliner would come home without a crew.
To undock, twelve hooks open, and springs on Starliner's docking ring push it away from the station.
[short pause] Separation came about two hundred sixty miles over central China.
This was the view from Starliner as it backed away from the docking port it left behind.
The new plan for Wilmore and Williams was a ride home on a SpaceX Dragon.
outcome: Starliner pulled away with no one aboard, and its two astronauts stayed on the station.
title: Starliner left its crew in space
description:
On Sept. 6, 2024, Boeing's Starliner undocked from the International Space Station without a crew after helium leaks and thruster issues on its first crewed flight. NASA astronauts Butch Wilmore and Suni Williams remained aboard the station, to return on a SpaceX Dragon.

facts.claim: Starliner undocked from the station Sept. 6 for a landing at White Sands
facts.source_quote: The Boeing Starliner spacecraft undocked from the forward port of the Harmony module of the International Space Station Sept. 6, for a landing at White Sands Space Harbor in New Mexico.

facts.claim: Wilmore and Williams launched June 5 on Starliner's first crewed flight
facts.source_quote: NASA astronauts Butch Wilmore and Suni Williams launched aboard Boeing’s Starliner spacecraft on June 5 for its first crewed flight, arriving at the space station on June 6.

facts.claim: Helium leaks and thruster issues on approach
facts.source_quote: As Starliner approached the orbiting laboratory, NASA and Boeing identified helium leaks and experienced issues with the spacecraft reaction control thrusters.

facts.claim: Returned without a crew; astronauts stayed, to ride home on Dragon
facts.source_quote: For the safety of the astronauts, NASA announced on Aug. 24 that Starliner will return to Earth from the station without a crew. Wilmore and Williams will remain aboard the station and return home in February 2025 aboard the SpaceX Dragon spacecraft

facts.claim: Twelve hooks open, springs push it away
facts.source_quote: ONCE ALL 12 HOOKS ARE OPEN, SPRINGS ON STARLINER's DOCKING RING WILL PUSH IT AWAY FROM THE SPACE STATION.
